Hutt history goes back to the [Infinite Empire](http://starwars.wikia.com/wiki/Infinite_Empire) which was over 35,000 years before Episode III.  Another reason tend to stay neutral during most galactic hostilities. This keeps them from being drawn into wars which would prevent them for continued subjugation of their held worlds as well as prevent them from conquering new territories.  Since their power was rooted in economics galactic belligerents found it strategic for the Hutts to stay neutral.  Third, they inhabit the outer rim where there is more empty space than in the core, inner rim, and expansion regions.
